gloss: A representation that states what it cannot express, where its users will meet the statement
mechanism: A map, model, chart, summary or other {{artifact}} that represents something carries a statement of what it cannot express and where its omissions lie. The statement names specific omissions and sits where users of the representation meet it, not in separate documentation.
invariants: States specific things the representation cannot express.
The statement sits where users of the representation meet it.
failure_modes: Buried caveat: the omission statement exists where no user looks.
Ritual caveat: a generic disclaimer names no specific omission.
